paragraphs.intro: From the beginning, we believed a pastry should be more than a treat. It should be a moment to pause, connect, and appreciate something made with intention.
paragraphs.outro: Today, that same care still guides everything we do. Every batch carries the spirit of curiosity, craftsmanship, and quiet respect for the journey each pastry takes before it reaches your table.

faq.title: Everything you need to know about the Maison

items.question: Do you offer gluten-free or nut-free options?
items.answer: Several signatures are prepared without gluten or nuts. Ask our team in salon or mention it in your order notes and we'll guide you.

items.question: How should I store my pastries at home?
items.answer: Most pastries are best enjoyed the day of purchase, kept cool and away from direct sunlight. Chocolates and gift boxes keep for up to two weeks in a cool, dry place.

items.question: Can I order a gift box for delivery?
items.answer: Yes — gift boxes can be ordered online or in salon and shipped for special occasions. Delivery windows vary by region.

items.question: Do you cater private events?
items.answer: We do. From small gatherings to full patisserie tables, our team can build a menu around your event — reach out through the contact page.

items.question: What's the best way to enjoy the hot chocolate?
items.answer: Slowly, and ideally paired with a Mont-Blanc. It's served rich and thick, in the traditional Parisian style.

items.question: What's the difference between the classic and seasonal collections?
items.answer: Classics are always on the menu; seasonal signatures rotate a few times a year around fresh, in-season ingredients.
